rationale: The agent authenticated the user via email and correctly identified the user’s orders. It successfully updated the shipping address for order #W1092119 to the account address, exchanged the tablet in order #W1603792 for a cheaper variant, processed the refund, and updated the default address, all consistent with tool outputs and eligibility (both orders were pending). However, it violated policy by performing an order-changing write (updating the shipping address on #W1092119) without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation. Similarly, it changed the user’s default address without a prior explicit confirmation step. While the exchange had clear user selection of the replacement item, the lack of confirmation before the initial write causes the interaction to fail the pass bar. All other details and outcomes were accurate and supported by the tools.
